summary: Thailand's Joint Information Centre challenged foreign and Cambodian accounts of the border conflict, stating that historical colonial-era treaties should not be broadly applied and maintaining that Thai forces are strictly adhering to agreed troop freeze positions.
title: Thailand Challenges Cambodian Historical Claims and Press Reports in Border Dispute

summary: Cambodia called for full adherence to the December 2025 ceasefire as thousands of displaced civilians remain unable to return home, while emphasizing the crucial verification role of the ASEAN Observer Team along border flashpoints.
title: Cambodia Urges Full Compliance with Ceasefire as ASEAN Observers Continue Monitoring

summary: The Cambodian government lodged a formal protest against Thailand regarding recent military construction, demolition of civilian homes, and alleged administrative encroachment in border areas since late August 2026, violating the December 2025 ceasefire agreement.
title: Cambodia Protests Ongoing Territorial Violations and Construction by Thai Forces

summary: The Thai military escorted media and ASEAN observers to a captured cyber-scam compound near the border, revealing facilities allegedly tied to trafficking and illegal organ removal.
title: Scam base on Thai-Cambodia border linked to organ trafficking

summary: Ambassadors from Thailand and Cambodia clashed at a UN Human Rights Council session in Geneva, trading accusations over ceasefire violations, territorial claims, and ongoing civilian displacement.
title: UN clash in Geneva as Thailand attempts to dismiss Cambodia's claims

summary: Thailand is constructing an 8.4-kilometre concrete border wall topped with barbed wire, starting with a completed one-kilometre stretch in Chanthaburi province, following deadly border clashes with Cambodia last year. The military states the wall aims to curb illegal smuggling and enhance security, though some local farmland has been impacted.
title: Fenced off: Thailand builds border wall after Cambodia clashes

summary: Foreign ministers of Cambodia and Thailand delivered opening statements on Tuesday at the first meeting of a UN arbitration process under UNCLOS in Singapore to resolve a long-running maritime boundary dispute in the Gulf of Thailand.
title: Cambodia and Thailand begin UN-backed conciliation on maritime dispute

summary: Foreign ministers of Thailand and Cambodia opened UN-backed conciliation talks in Singapore on Tuesday to address their long-running maritime boundary dispute in the hydrocarbon-rich Gulf of Thailand.
title: Thailand and Cambodia begin UN conciliation process over disputed maritime claims

summary: Thailand and Cambodia presented arguments at the Permanent Court of Arbitration in Singapore regarding overlapping maritime claims, with both sides trading accusations over historical facts while expressing a desire to rebuild trust.
title: Thailand, Cambodia take maritime dispute to international mediation

summary: Nine months after a ceasefire between Thailand and Cambodia, over 20,000 displaced villagers remain unable to return home, living in a resettlement camp known as the 'Waiting Village' in Banteay Meanchey province amid ongoing disputes over border troop positions.
title: In Cambodia's 'Waiting Village', tattooist mourns trade lost to war

summary: Cambodian Prime Minister Hun Manet accused Thailand of using anti-scam operations as a pretext to expand into Cambodian territory during a regional conference, while reiterating vows to eradicate online scams.
title: Cambodia accuses Thailand of using scam crackdowns as excuse for attacks

summary: Cambodia's Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Prak Sokhonn addressed the 81st session of the UN General Assembly, calling for a fair and lasting settlement to border and maritime disputes with Thailand, the resumption of Joint Boundary Commission work, and noting that over 20,000 Cambodian civilians remain displaced.
title: Cambodia seeks fair, lasting border settlement with Thailand, presses for sovereign equality at UN

summary: At the UN General Assembly, Cambodian Foreign Minister Prak Sokhonn urged Thailand to respect border agreements and ceasefire commitments while defending Cambodia's pursuit of maritime dispute conciliation via UNCLOS following recent tensions.
title: Cambodia urges border action, defends maritime conciliation after Thai PM's UN criticism
